delegationId.description:
id of the delegation.

To be passed in the request only for edit and delete delegation.

Returned in the response for fetch API.

userName.description: It is required only for POST create user.

email.description: For internal users, a notification with password will be sent to the email.

userType.description: INTERNAL users are the users which directly login in Converis. External users are the users that login through SSO, e.g. Shibboleth

lastLogin.description: The date-time notation as defined by RFC 3339, section 5.6, e.g. "2017-07-21T17:32:28"

startDate.description:
The date when the role delegation starts. Values must follow the pattern yyyy-MM-dd.

If this date is not provided, it is defaulted to current date.

In case of update API, if there is no change in the start date, it is expected to send the existing unchanged value of the start date.

endDate.description:
The date when the role delegation ends. Values must follow the pattern yyyy-MM-dd.

In case of update API, if there is no change in the end date, it is expected to send the existing unchanged value of the end date.

roleName.description: Converis user role - Please carefully check your Converis configuration. Do not provide names of the specific language. Special role names for admins can be used: Config Admin or Super Admin. For special roles no entryPointId is needed.

entryPointDataUrl.description: The entrypoint data url - only by GET Request

entryPointDefinitionUrl.description: Entry point definition url - only by GET Request
